name: Misr Life Insurance Company S.A.E.
source: MUTXRI CRON 18 Nov 2026: Misr Life Insurance Company S.A.E., Intention to Float announcement dated 17 November 2026, Balance Sheet Highlights table (page 7), audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (footnote 24). Figures printed in EGP million and stored here as absolute EGP.
source_note: Total assets and shareholders' equity only, both as printed in the issuer's highlights table: total assets 92,688 million EGP, shareholders' equity 44,047 million EGP, paid-in capital 5,000 million EGP. The table gives no current or non-current split, so those rows stay empty rather than being estimated. Total investments of 87,656 million EGP and insurance and reinsurance contract liabilities of 35,957 million EGP are printed in the same table and are not balance rows this panel renders.
